draft_en.subject: 8-port 10G copper — two units that match
draft_en.body:
Hi, Nate,

In April 2025 you asked for a small switch with about 8 x 10G copper ports plus 2-4 x 10G SFP+, and we said "not on the list"; in September we quoted the 24-SFP unit instead, which was not what you asked for.

Two units now match, both on our commercial (Realtek) line, neutral brand, AC input, 1U:
- 8 x 10G multi-gig copper (100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G) + 4 x 10G SFP+, web-managed (VLAN, IGMP snooping, port stats): $204 USD EXW
- 8 x 10G multi-gig copper, unmanaged: $181.5 USD EXW
(2026-10 price table, valid 15 days from this mail; 1-year warranty on the commercial line (3 years on industrial models).)

If it must be full L2+/L3 managed, the smallest managed 10GBASE-T unit is 24 x 10G copper + 2 x 100G on the CENTEC line (quoted at $1,700 USD in July 2026 to another customer; lead time confirmed at order).

One question: for your San Antonio projects, is the 8 x 10G + 4 x SFP+ web-managed unit enough, or do you need CLI/SNMP management on it?

Thank you.
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
